title: Eric Lopes refuses to talk and threatens film crew

plain: Documentary filmmaker James Fox says that while filming in Varginha, a Brazilian town tied to a story of a captured alien, his crew tried to reach a man named Eric Lopes. Fox says they were told that if they had come to talk about the ET, the extraterrestrial, Lopes would not talk, and that the crew were threatened with being shot. He tells it as a sign that people there are still afraid to speak.
